The '''94th Fighter/Attack Squadron''' was a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the command of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Kip Famas]], the 94th was based out of [[Polis Massa Research Base]] while the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was conducting tests of the experimental [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE/ph phantom]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in the [[Polis Massa system/Legends|surrounding region]]. Along with the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] of the [[88th Attack Squadron]], the 94th was tasked with eliminating the Imperial threat. The squadron lost at least four X-wings, but the Imperials were eventually forced to abandon the tests and withdraw from the area.<ref name="Strongholds" />
